"""Hand-computed semantic scenarios (dev only)."""
import json, subprocess, sys
CAND = '/workspace/submission/main.py'

TMPL = 'aabbcc1100020500'   # kinds KKKDZQTK : K=0,1,2,7 D=3 Z=4 Q=5 T=6
KINDS = 'KKKDZQTK'


def flow(fid, path, labels, tmpl=TMPL, kinds=KINDS):
    f = dict(id=fid, path=path, template=tmpl, kinds=kinds)
    if labels is not None:
        f['labels'] = labels
    return f


def replay(caps, flows, events):
    return dict(mode='replay', capacities=caps, flows=flows, events=events)


def pkt(fid, header, payload=''):
    return dict(op='packet', flow=fid, header=header, payload=payload)


CASES = []

# --- A: label reuse / drain barrier / full / busy -----------------------------
A = replay({'s0': 1, 'r': 1},
           [flow('A', ['s0', 'r'], [100, 200]), flow('B', ['s0', 'r'], [100, 201])],
           [dict(op='put', flow='A', node='s0'),
            dict(op='put', flow='A', node='r'),
            dict(op='enable', flow='A'),
            dict(op='put', flow='A', node='s0'),          # idempotent while enabled
            dict(op='put', flow='B', node='s0'),          # busy
            dict(op='disable', flow='A'),
            dict(op='put', flow='B', node='s0'),          # overwrite inactive -> ok
            dict(op='put', flow='B', node='r'),           # full (r cap 1 holds A@200)
            dict(op='enable', flow='B'),                 # unready
            pkt('A', 'aabbcc2233040900', 'ee'),
            dict(op='reset'),
            dict(op='put', flow='B', node='r'),           # still full
            dict(op='enable', flow='B')])
A_exp = dict(
    results=[{'status': 'ok'}, {'status': 'ok'}, {'status': 'ok'}, {'status': 'ok'},
             {'status': 'busy'}, {'status': 'ok'}, {'status': 'ok'}, {'status': 'full'},
             {'status': 'unready'},
             dict(mode='ip', reason='disabled',
                  wire=['aabbcc223304090 0ee'.replace(' ', ''), 'aabbcc2233040800ee'],
                  delivered='aabbcc2233040800ee', byte_hops=18),
             {'status': 'ok'}, {'status': 'full'}, {'status': 'unready'}],
    active=[], tables=[dict(node='r', label=200, flow='A'), dict(node='s0', label=100, flow='B')])
CASES.append(('label-reuse', A, A_exp))

# --- B: TTL boundaries in MPLS and IP (N=2) -----------------------------------
capsB = {'s0': 2, 'r': 2}
flowsB = [flow('M', ['s0', 'r'], [16, 17])]
evB = [dict(op='put', flow='M', node='s0'), dict(op='put', flow='M', node='r'),
       dict(op='enable', flow='M'),
       pkt('M', 'aabbcc2233040000'),   # ttl 0
       pkt('M', 'aabbcc2233040100'),   # ttl 1 -> one link then drop at s0
       pkt('M', 'aabbcc2233040200'),   # ttl 2 -> delivered with ttl 1
       dict(op='disable', flow='M'),
       pkt('M', 'aabbcc2233040100', 'ab'),  # ip ttl 1
       pkt('M', 'aabbcc2233040000', 'ab'),  # ip ttl 0
       pkt('M', 'aabbcc2233040200', 'ab')]  # ip ttl 2 delivered
B_exp = dict(results=[{'status': 'ok'}, {'status': 'ok'}, {'status': 'ok'},
                      dict(mode='mpls', reason='compressed', wire=[], delivered=None, byte_hops=0),
                      dict(mode='mpls', reason='compressed', wire=['0001090177'[:0] + '00010901' + '22'],
                           delivered=None, byte_hops=5),
                      dict(mode='mpls', reason='compressed',
                           wire=['00010902' + '22', '00011901' + '22'],
                           delivered='aabbcc22000401' + '00', byte_hops=10),
                      {'status': 'ok'},
                      dict(mode='ip', reason='disabled', wire=['aabbcc2233040100ab'],
                           delivered=None, byte_hops=9),
                      dict(mode='ip', reason='disabled', wire=[], delivered=None, byte_hops=0),
                      dict(mode='ip', reason='disabled',
                           wire=['aabbcc2233040200ab', 'aabbcc2233040100ab'],
                           delivered='aabbcc2233040100ab', byte_hops=18)],
             active=[], tables=[dict(node='r', label=17, flow='M'), dict(node='s0', label=16, flow='M')])
CASES.append(('ttl-boundaries', replay(capsB, flowsB, evB), B_exp))

# --- C: classification order: mismatch before qos, qos boundary ---------------
capsC = {'s0': 1, 'r': 1}
flowsC = [flow('C', ['s0', 'r'], [16, 17])]
evC = [dict(op='put', flow='C', node='s0'), dict(op='put', flow='C', node='r'),
       dict(op='enable', flow='C'),
       pkt('C', 'aabbcc223307ff00'),      # Q=7 -> mpls
       pkt('C', 'aabbcc223308ff00'),      # Q=8 -> ip/qos
       pkt('C', 'aabb002233ff0900'),      # K mismatch (byte2) + Q=0xff -> mismatch wins
       pkt('C', 'aabbcc2233ff0900')]      # Q=255 -> qos
C_exp = dict(results=[{'status': 'ok'}, {'status': 'ok'}, {'status': 'ok'},
                      dict(mode='mpls', reason='compressed',
                           wire=['00010e09' + '22', '00011e08' + '22'],
                           delivered='aabbcc22000708' + '00', byte_hops=10),
                      dict(mode='ip', reason='qos',
                           wire=['aabbcc223308ff00', 'aabbcc223307ff00'],
                           delivered='aabbcc223307ff00', byte_hops=16),
                      dict(mode='ip', reason='mismatch',
                           wire=['aabb002233ff0900', 'aabb002233ff0800'],
                           delivered='aabb002233ff0800', byte_hops=16),
                      dict(mode='ip', reason='qos',
                           wire=['aabbcc2233ff0900', 'aabbcc2233ff0800'],
                           delivered='aabbcc2233ff0800', byte_hops=16)],
             active=['C'], tables=[dict(node='r', label=17, flow='C'), dict(node='s0', label=16, flow='C')])
CASES.append(('classification', replay(capsC, flowsC, evC), C_exp))

# --- D: multiple D bytes residue order + Z normalisation + longer path --------
# kinds: D K Z D Q T K D  (H=8) -> one Q one T, K count 3, D count 3, 4+3<8 ok
kindsD = 'DKZDQTKD'
tmplD = '1122334455667788'
flowsD = [flow('D', ['a', 'b', 'c', 'd'], [16, 17, 18, 19], tmpl=tmplD, kinds=kindsD)]
capsD = {'a': 1, 'b': 1, 'c': 1, 'd': 1}
hdrD = 'ff22aa445509' + '77' + 'bb'    # D bytes at 0,3,7 = ff,44,bb ; Q=05? -> build below
hdrD = 'ff' + '22' + 'aa' + '44' + '55' + '09' + '77' + 'bb'   # Q=0x55>7 -> would be qos; fix
hdrD = 'ff' + '22' + 'aa' + '44' + '03' + '09' + '77' + 'bb'   # Q=3, T=9
evD = [dict(op='put', flow='D', node=x) for x in ['a', 'b', 'c', 'd']] + \
      [dict(op='enable', flow='D'), pkt('D', hdrD, '00ff')]
# residue = D bytes in increasing offset order: ff 44 bb ; N=4 links, ttl 9,8,7,6
wire = []
for j, lab in enumerate([16, 17, 18, 19]):
    word = (lab << 12) | (3 << 9) | (1 << 8) | (9 - j)
    wire.append('%08x' % word + 'ff44bb' + '00ff')
# delivered: K from tmpl (22 at1, 77 at6), Z zero at2, D from residue, Q=3, T=9-3=6
D_exp = dict(results=[{'status': 'ok'}] * 4 + [{'status': 'ok'},
             dict(mode='mpls', reason='compressed', wire=wire,
                  delivered='ff220044' + '03' + '06' + '77bb' + '00ff',
                  byte_hops=4 * (4 + 3 + 2))],
             active=['D'], tables=[dict(node='a', label=16, flow='D'), dict(node='b', label=17, flow='D'),
                                   dict(node='c', label=18, flow='D'), dict(node='d', label=19, flow='D')])
CASES.append(('multi-D', replay(capsD, flowsD, evD), D_exp))

# --- E: reset keeps tables, stale entries reusable ----------------------------
flowsE = [flow('E', ['s0', 'r'], [16, 17]), flow('F', ['s0', 'r'], [18, 19])]
evE = [dict(op='put', flow='E', node='s0'), dict(op='put', flow='E', node='r'),
       dict(op='enable', flow='E'), dict(op='put', flow='F', node='s0'),  # full (cap 1)
       dict(op='reset'),
       pkt('E', 'aabbcc2233040500'),   # disabled now
       dict(op='enable', flow='E'),    # ok again from stale entries
       pkt('E', 'aabbcc2233040500')]
E_exp = dict(results=[{'status': 'ok'}, {'status': 'ok'}, {'status': 'ok'}, {'status': 'full'},
                      {'status': 'ok'},
                      dict(mode='ip', reason='disabled',
                           wire=['aabbcc2233040500', 'aabbcc2233040400'],
                           delivered='aabbcc2233040400', byte_hops=16),
                      {'status': 'ok'},
                      dict(mode='mpls', reason='compressed',
                           wire=['0001070522', '0001170422'],
                           delivered='aabbcc2200040400', byte_hops=10)],
             active=['E'], tables=[dict(node='r', label=17, flow='E'), dict(node='s0', label=16, flow='E')])
CASES.append(('reset-stale', replay({'s0': 1, 'r': 1}, flowsE, evE), E_exp))

# --- F: two flows sharing a label at different nodes; both enabled ------------
flowsF = [flow('P', ['n1', 'n2'], [50, 51]), flow('Q', ['n2', 'n1'], [50, 51])]
evF = [dict(op='put', flow='P', node='n1'), dict(op='put', flow='P', node='n2'),
       dict(op='put', flow='Q', node='n2'), dict(op='put', flow='Q', node='n1'),
       dict(op='enable', flow='P'), dict(op='enable', flow='Q'),
       pkt('P', 'aabbcc2233040300'), pkt('Q', 'aabbcc2233040300')]
F_exp = dict(results=[{'status': 'ok'}] * 4 + [{'status': 'ok'}, {'status': 'ok'},
             dict(mode='mpls', reason='compressed', wire=['00032703' + '22', '00033702' + '22'],
                  delivered='aabbcc2200040200', byte_hops=10),
             dict(mode='mpls', reason='compressed', wire=['00032703' + '22', '00033702' + '22'],
                  delivered='aabbcc2200040200', byte_hops=10)],
             active=['P', 'Q'],
             tables=[dict(node='n1', label=50, flow='P'), dict(node='n1', label=51, flow='Q'),
                     dict(node='n2', label=50, flow='Q'), dict(node='n2', label=51, flow='P')])
CASES.append(('shared-labels', replay({'n1': 2, 'n2': 2}, flowsF, evF), F_exp))


def main():
    lines = [json.dumps(req) for _, req, _ in CASES]
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '-B', CAND], input=''.join(l + '\n' for l in lines),
                       text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=120)
    got = p.stdout.splitlines()
    fails = 0
    for i, (name, req, exp) in enumerate(CASES):
        try:
            g = json.loads(got[i])
        except Exception:
            g = got[i] if i < len(got) else None
        if g != exp:
            fails += 1
            print('FAIL', name)
            for j, (a, b) in enumerate(zip(g.get('results', []) if isinstance(g, dict) else [],
                                           exp['results'])):
                if a != b:
                    print('  ev%d in : %s' % (j, json.dumps(req['events'][j])))
                    print('  got: %s' % json.dumps(a))
                    print('  exp: %s' % json.dumps(b))
            if isinstance(g, dict):
                for k in ('active', 'tables'):
                    if g.get(k) != exp[k]:
                        print('  %s got %s exp %s' % (k, json.dumps(g.get(k)), json.dumps(exp[k])))
            else:
                print('  raw got:', str(g)[:300])
    print('scenarios done fails=%d/%d' % (fails, len(CASES)))
    if p.stderr:
        print('STDERR', p.stderr[:400])


main()
PYEOF
